summary.text: Fred Deutsch is a Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 4, and a former state representative who held the seat from 2015 to 2017 and from 2019 to 2025.
He is a chiropractor in Watertown.

paragraphs.text: Deutsch is the owner and operator of a chiropractic office in Watertown, South Dakota, and previously served on the Watertown School Board.
He first served in the House from 2015 to 2017 and returned to the chamber in 2019.
In the 2023–2024 session he was vice chair of the House Education Committee and also served on the Health and Human Services and Military and Veterans' Affairs committees.
Deutsch did not seek re-election to the House in 2024 and instead ran for the District 4 State Senate seat, losing the June 4, 2024 Republican primary to Stephanie Sauder by 1,868 votes to 1,804.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary for the District 4 House seats, receiving 25.7 percent of the vote.
